title: CrooksJarzynskiLean: a Lean 4 formalization of the Crooks and Jarzynski fluctuation theorems
description: A machine-checked development of stochastic thermodynamics in Lean 4. For finite-state continuous-time Markov jump processes on a fixed finite horizon, it constructs the normalized trajectory law from a conservative generator, proves finite-horizon non-explosion, and identifies the terminal and all finite-dimensional marginals with the matrix-exponential semigroup exp(tQ). Concatenating finitely many constant-generator windows separated by instantaneous energy quenches, it proves the path-space Crooks relation, the Crooks work-distribution relation, Jarzynski's equality, and the average-work second law on the constructed global path laws, together with trajectory-level time-reversal mirror theorems and the identity between mean dissipated work and path-space relative entropy. A broader discrete-time measure-theoretic development with Gaussian, Metropolis-Hastings, and finite-state examples supports the library. Release v1.0.0 archives the formalization together with the accompanying manuscript, its bibliography, the paper-to-declaration map, and the reviewer-oriented artifact guide. The build is pinned by lean-toolchain, lakefile.lean, and lake-manifest.json; continuous integration rejects sorry/admit and custom axioms and audits the kernel axioms of the headline theorems (only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound are permitted).
